content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are having a great week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few small adjustments before signing. Specifically, regarding the relevant clause, you are required to indemnify the client for any breach or violation without any monetary cap or limitation, exposing you to potentially unlimited financial risk. To make this work, I suggest the following change: The Contractor's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid to the Contractor under this Agreement, excluding any liability arising from gross negligence or willful misconduct. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
